# AI News Daily (maysunAI/ai-news-daily)

> A daily, auto-generated digest of AI news with primary-source links, summaries,
> original-language tags, and a transparent 0-100 importance score. Summaries are
> written in Chinese and machine-translated to English; both languages are kept.

Last updated: 2026-10-29
Web version: https://ainews.maysuns.uk/digest.html
Author: https://maysuns.uk
Topics: AI news, LLMs, generative AI, open source, AI policy, research

## Scoring

0-100 per item. Source tier (official +40 / major media +25 / secondary +10)
+ category event weight + keyword hits. >=60 is flagged. Rationale: journalism
source tiers, NewsGuard's 0-100/60 threshold, OpenSSF weighted-signal scoring.
